summary: First full run. Backend: 16 pytest cases (14 core all PASS; 2 validation-gap probes FAIL). All requested core flows work end-to-end on web preview (390x844): welcome -> sign in (guest prefilled) -> home feed -> event details -> qty/promoter code MARCO1 -> buy -> ticket QR; venues search -> venue -> service -> reserve -> reservation-success; profile tickets/reservations/wallet/sign out; sign-up role->tier->form->home; promoter Promote tab (stats, referral code, QR, leaderboard), scan -> check-in (success + 'Already checked in'). Fee math verified (15% fee, promoter 40% of fee, wallet increments, $2 withdrawal fee). Main bugs: home category chips do not filter, membership tier is self-assignable (free premium/corporate), reservation price/party size are client-controlled with no validation (negative totals accepted and shown in UI). Payments are MOCKED (simulated).

critical.issue: Client sets base_price and there is no validation: base_price=-100, party_size=-3, service_type='x' returns 201 with total -115, and Profile shows '$-115'. The price should come from the server based on venue and service_type; party_size>=1 and service_type should be an enum.

Users can pick any membership_tier, including premium, corporate and venue, and get 201. Anyone can give themselves a paid tier for free. Only free_girl and trial_male (or member) should be self-selectable; premium needs payment and venue/corporate need an admin.

minor.issue: Not atomic: balance check and $inc are separate, so parallel requests can push the wallet negative. Use find_one_and_update with filter wallet_balance>=amount. Any role (including guest) can call it.
Not atomic (two parallel check-ins can both succeed). Use update_one({id, checked_in:false}). Any promoter can also check in tickets for any venue or event; there is no ownership scope.

No upper limit on quantity. Tickets can be bought for past events. A promoter can use their own MARCO1 code on their own purchases and earn from them. An invalid promoter_code is silently ignored (no feedback to the user).
price is not validated (negative values allowed). A venue_owner can create events for any venue, not only their own.
q goes into $regex without re.escape, so regex injection / ReDoS is possible.
N+1 user lookups. Use $lookup or a single $in query.
@app.on_event is deprecated; use a lifespan handler.

ui_bugs.issue: The category state is set but never used to filter events. Tapping 'Tonight', 'Rooftop' and the others still shows every card (9 → 9). Reference: app/(tabs)/index.tsx:29

The ticket screen shows the short code '#32993EB1', but entering it on the check-in screen returns 'Not Found'; only the full UUID works. Accept the short code (or strip '#' and match a prefix), or add camera QR scanning (expo-camera), since the button is labelled scan.

Always withdraws the full cached user.wallet_balance and has no amount input. With $0 the button stays enabled and shows 'Amount must be positive'. Disable it when balance <= $2. The wallet value is only refreshed after a withdraw, so it goes stale after new sales.
The scan button is shown to guests. Check-in only works for promoter, venue_owner and admin, so hide it for guests.
Once, tapping scan-btn right after switching back from the Promote tab did not navigate. It worked on 3 other attempts.

issues: The Withdraw gradient does not fill its Pressable (box 166px wide, gradient about 118px), and it has square corners while every other CTA is a rounded pill. It looks broken.
On web, TextInputs get a white rectangular browser focus outline inside the rounded field (visible on venue-search). Add outlineStyle:'none' for web.
The tier badge shows the raw key 'FREE GIRL'. Use friendly labels such as 'Free · Women'.
The copy says 'you can switch later', but there is no way to switch roles.
Seeded event times are relative to now (for example 3:32 AM), which looks odd for nightlife. Seed fixed evening times instead.

action_items: Calculate reservation prices on the server from venue and service_type. Validate party_size>=1, service_type as an enum, and base_price>0 using Pydantic Field constraints.
Restrict membership_tier at registration to the free or trial tiers (block premium, corporate and venue unless paid or set by an admin).
Implement the home chip filter (Tonight, This Week, and category/tags such as Rooftop, Nightclub, Lounge, VIP).
Make withdraw and check-in atomic with conditional updates. Limit withdraw to promoter-type roles.
Let check-in accept the short ticket code shown on the ticket, or add QR scanning via expo-camera.
Fix the Withdraw button styling. Disable it when balance <= $2. Refresh the wallet (/auth/me) when the Profile screen gets focus.
Hide scan-btn for guests. Escape the regex in venue search. Validate ticket quantity (1-20) and reject past events.
Remove the hardcoded guest credentials prefilled on the sign-in screen before production.
critical_code_review_comments: sign-in.tsx:23-24 prefills real guest credentials. That is fine for a demo but must be removed for production.
Payments are MOCKED: purchase, reservation and withdraw only write records, and the withdraw message says 'Sent ... to your bank'.
Promoter stats are aggregated from tickets but the wallet is a separate counter. They diverge after withdrawals, which is expected, but label them clearly (Total earned vs Available).
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner, expo-background-fetch) were found. No raw HTML elements or className usage were found.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (all requested flows pass; chip filter broken; short-code check-in unsupported)

seed_data_creation: No seed data created. The tests created TEST_ users, a TEST_Event, guest tickets and reservations; all were removed by exact id via cleanup_iteration1.py (records created in the last 10 min) and event tickets_sold was decremented. The seeded promoter wallet went 0 -> 9.60 -> 6.60 (API withdraw $3) -> 0.00 (UI withdraw), so it ended back at its seed value.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from frontend/.env and pytest backend/tests/test_nocturne_api.py. The TestValidationGaps tests are expected to pass once the validation fixes land. Note that the system clock is Nov 2026. The frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Checking in needs the full ticket UUID (the ticket URL /ticket/{uuid}).
rca_of_issue: Chips: in (tabs)/index.tsx the category useState is only used for chip highlighting and never applied to the events list. Tier and reservation gaps: the RegisterIn and ReservationIn Pydantic models have no constraints, and the server trusts the client's base_price.
